text:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — FathomWorks renewal ~6 weeks out. Noticed their token usage dropped ~48% MoM and several dev keys inactive. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/fathomworks (view-only)
Ajay (AE): Yep — I met procurement last week. They ran a quick smoke with EchoAI and asked for latency/cost comparisons. No PO yet. Champion S. Carter still engaged but quiet.
Maria (CS): Any sign of stakeholder change? who owns the integration now?
Ajay (AE): Champion is same (Lydia). Procurement assigned new contact (S. Carter). Engineering lead (M. Ortiz) is on parental leave, so decisions are slower.
Sylvie (AM): Triage recommendation:
- Quick 30m health + procurement sync this week
- Share a short benchmark + cost delta for their top workload
- Offer a 2-week Dedicated eval (reserved pool) to show predictable latency
Can we get enablement + infra to prepare artifacts?
Zoe (Enablement): I can assemble a 1-pager + 5-slide benchmark deck by EOD tomorrow. I also have a template "Redwood vs Hosted Alternatives" that calls out caching/kv benefits.
PlatformBot: Metrics snapshot (generated): active API keys: 42 -> 21, avg tokens/day: 1.2M -> 0.62M, 95p latency (prod) increased 18ms after model pin change. Recent errors: 2 client-timeouts in last 7 days.
Maria (CS): Good data. Ajay — can you confirm which model they used with EchoAI? we should match the workload.
Ajay (AE): They tested Echo's small LLM (embed+chat) — likely comparable to our rd-3b quantized profile. I'll confirm.
Sylvie (AM): Prep plan for the call:
1) Quick recap of usage and timeline
2) Show cost+latency comparison (Zoe)
3) Offer Dedicated 2-week eval + success criteria (playbook)
4) Next steps: technical deep-dive if they accept
Maria (CS): Ajay — suggested pre-call email (short):
```
Hi Lydia & Sam,
Quick check-in — Maria (CS) and I noticed reduced activity and wanted to sync before renewal. Can we do 30m Fri to review a short benchmark and a proposed 2-week Dedicated eval to validate latency/cost for your production traffic? No heavy ops required on your side.
Proposed agenda attached.
Thanks, Ajay
```
Ajay (AE): Sending now. Calendar invite: Fri 11:00am PT — Sent to Lydia, S. Carter, M. Ortiz (outlook: tentative). Invite includes link to dashboard and the pre-read deck (placeholder).
Zoe (Enablement): Uploading deck to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/pres/fathomworks-benchmark
Sylvie (AM): I'll draft a success criteria checklist for the eval (SLOs, traffic pattern, acceptance window). Maria — can you own post-call followups?
Maria (CS): Yep. I'll capture action items and open a renewal play ticket.
Ajay (AE): Quick ask — procurement asked for a short contract addendum template for a temporary eval. @Zoe can you attach a sample?
Zoe (Enablement): Attaching sample clause in the drive. See section 'Temporary Eval — Terms' (two-paragraph, non-binding).
Maria (CS): Nice. If they mention competitor features, call out our routing/fallback and KV caching as differentiation.
Sylvie (AM): +1 :thumbsup:
Ajay (AE): Will report back after the call. Keeping thisHigh priority. :eyes:
PlatformBot: NOTE: Flagged account for "renewal_risk:monitor" and created ticket CS-7842.
Maria (CS): Thanks all — plan looks good. Follow-ups after Fri call.
